sourceOffers.question: What should the next slice after the single-SVG export cover while editing interaction stays undecided?

options.label: Single SVG export from local data first
options.tradeoff: Delivers the agreed export baseline, but leaves the requested editing entirely for a later slice.
options.acceptanceExample: Given local board data, when the first slice runs, then it exports exactly one SVG and reports any data that cannot export.

source.quote: The first board exports one SVG from local data.

options.label: Decide editing interaction before building it
options.tradeoff: Prevents building the wrong editing UI, but delays any editable behavior until the interaction is chosen by a person.
options.acceptanceExample: Given editing is requested, when the next slice is scoped, then it decides the interaction style first and builds only that agreed interaction.

source.quote: Editing is requested, but its interaction style is undecided.

options.label: Hold the next slice for an explicit person decision
options.tradeoff: Keeps the undecided slice honestly open, but ships nothing further until the decision is made.
options.acceptanceExample: Given the next slice is undecided, when a person picks one option, then only that slice is built and the other remains explicitly open.
